description: Edit one or more existing images with OpenAI image editing and save outputs to your workspace.

background.description: Background style. 'transparent' produces a cutout with an alpha channel; it requires png or webp output. The default model supports it; gpt-image-2 does not.

count.description: How many output images to generate (1-8).

image_paths.description: Absolute or workspace-relative paths to reference images. PNG/JPEG/WEBP only.

mask_path.description: Optional PNG mask. Transparent areas define the edit region.

output_compression.description: Compression level 0-100 (higher = better quality, larger file). Only applies when output_format is jpeg or webp.

output_format.description: Output file format (defaults to png). jpeg and webp produce smaller files; only png and webp support transparency.

prompt.description: What to change in the image. Describe the edit in plain language.

quality.description: Output quality (defaults to high). Medium is usually about 10-20 seconds and $0.01-0.02; high usually takes 20-60 seconds and costs about $0.05-0.08.

name: edit_image
title: Edit Image
